lead_headline: Five-day subscriber freeze finally breaks with single annual add; restaurant tracker flatlines with zero new leads as Snarf's Hampden and El Pollo Loco Colfax confirm same-day openings

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — tracker holds at 181 active (103 openings, 78 closures) while Snarf's Hampden and El Pollo Loco Lakewood both confirm May 19 openings, Spicy Kitchen Westminster transitions from truck to brick-and-mortar.

liquor.blurb: Day 22 of the blackout — Colorado's liquor license database extends its complete freeze through a fourth consecutive week with zero applications filed, zero status updates, zero activity across all counties since April 30. The May reporting cycle now entirely erased as 12,396 tracked licenses remain frozen in regulatory limbo. State officials maintain absolute silence on restoration timeline, applicant workarounds, or system failure root cause as backlogs compound daily.

reputation.blurb: Seven mentions yesterday — Denver Health rendering release, Atomic Cowboy tip settlement, Scarpaletto Larimer Square return lead Wednesday pickup — 7-day total climbs to 63 across 11 sources, up 47% from prior week's 43. Instagram dominates at 35% share (22 mentions), Facebook 16% (10), Denver Post and Reddit tied at 14% (9 each). Hoodline emerges with three enterprise pieces picking up BusinessDen scoops. Google News RSS claims 95% discovery (60 of 63). Month accelerates toward 231 as May pace outstrips April's close.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) — fifth consecutive zero day extends the acquisition freeze through an entire calendar week as MTD holds at +21 (+1.0/day), 90-day net remains +134. The seven-day window sits at +5 (6 new, 1 canceled), up from prior week's +3 but masking a stark bifurcation: May 12-15's concentrated +11 burst followed by seven days of absolute dormancy. YTD pace of +1.3/day continues tracking well ahead of the MTD crawl as the May momentum from mid-month gains evaporates into prolonged silence with no weekend recovery, no midweek rebound, no signal the engine's restarting.
